title: The Skill Code: Empowering People for Intelligent Transformation
description: In the age of AI, transformation starts with people—not just technology. Professor Nishit Narang of BITS Pilani (WILP) decodes how human skills, creativity, and adaptability can drive intelligent transformation across enterprises. Drawing from deep industry and academic experience, he explores how organizations can bridge the skill gap, foster continuous learning, and design AI-ready teams that thrive in change. Learn how to unlock “The Skill Code” to empower your workforce for the future of work.
